title: Resolution honoring disability rights advocate Becky Ogle
summary: This resolution honors the life and legacy of Becky Ogle, a disability rights advocate who helped secure passage of the Americans with Disabilities Act in 1990. It recognizes her decades of work advancing accessibility, inclusion and equal opportunity, including roles with the Democratic National Committee and the President's Taskforce on the Employment of People with Disabilities. Ogle died on October 18, 2026.
